_what: Per-site profile for the WHERE tab build. PAUSED 2026-08-17 at the deploy ceiling, after axnidentifiers.org shipped.
_task: A /where/ page on each heteronym's OWN site, in THAT site's typography and palette, showing the journal that heteronym edits, with a nav entry following the site's existing convention. The heteronyms live on those sites; their journals should too.

_done.method: Built from /assets/msa.css and nothing else — no inline <style>, and no class the Cranes card does not already use. Four plates: Journal, Editors, Issue, Elsewhere. Nav entry inserted directly after Who in the .stations bar on all eight pages, with .here on the current page.

_nav_conventions._rule: If the card is in the nav, Where goes in the nav beside it. If the card is standalone, Where goes standalone with it.

_remaining.note: card path is /ayanna/, NOT /who/. Site has both Voice and Who in nav; Where goes beside Who.
seven mantles collectively; no per-name card
NO editorial seat. A Where page here would point at the province, or be skipped. Card also returns 403 under Vercel deployment protection.

_open_decision: Hand-build each against its site's idiom (what axnidentifiers got), or write a generator taking a per-site style profile — wrapper markup, nav pattern, class names — that emits the same four plates into it. The generator keeps fidelity AND makes the pages regenerable when a venue record changes; hand-building is more faithful per site but goes stale silently. Not decided.
_deploy_state: PAUSED at the ceiling. machinemediation.org and watergiraffe.org were each one commit behind live at pause time, carrying the network-block de-duplication. The commit BEFORE it deployed on both, so the hook works and this is the ceiling, not a break. Verify with scripts/check_fleet_block.py --live before resuming.
